steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Environment
steps.instruction: Set up the workspace and cool necessary components to ensure sample stability.

substeps.instruction: Cool the centrifuge and necessary rotors to 2 °C.
Cool CellTrics filters in the fridge.
Ensure the working surface is clean and RNase-free.
Keep all solutions on ice and samples on dry ice.
Use pipette tips with filters.

steps.title: Tissue Fixation and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Fix the brain tissue and initiate the initial breakdown of the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL of cooled Fixation Solution to brain tissue (1/4 of a mouse brain) in a 1.5 mL tube kept on dry ice.
Place on ice and start timing.
Crush brain(s) with a disposable pellet pestle.
Transfer the suspension using a 1 mL wide-bore tip into a 2 mL tube containing 1.6 mL of cooled Fixation Solution.
Shake the sample on ice at 300 rpm for no longer than 10 minutes (counting from the start of timing).
Add 0.1 mL of 2.5M Glycine (final concentration 0.125M).
Mix the suspension manually by inverting.
Keep the sample on ice and shake at 300 rpm for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Nuclei Extraction and Washing
steps.instruction: Isolate nuclei through sequential washing and mechanical homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Spin the cell suspension at 1100 x g for 5 minutes at 2 °C.
Remove the supernatant by pipetting.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of ice-cold Lysis Buffer using 1 mL wide-bore tips (first wash).
Spin the cell suspension at 1100 x g for 5 minutes at 2 °C.
Remove the supernatant by pipetting.
Resuspend the pellet with 1 mL of ice-cold Lysis Buffer using 1 mL wide-bore tips (second wash).
Spin the cell suspension at 1100 x g for 5 minutes at 2 °C.
Remove the supernatant by pipetting.
Resuspend the pellet with 1 mL of ice-cold Lysis Buffer using 1 mL wide-bore tips.

steps.title: Mechanical Lysis and Filtration
steps.instruction: Break open cells using a Dounce homogenizer and filter the resulting suspension.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the mixture into a pre-cooled Dounce homogenizer.
While keeping the homogenizer on ice, homogenize with Pestle A (5 times for mouse / 15 times for human).
While keeping the homogenizer on ice, homogenize with Pestle B 10 times.
Transfer the homogenized solution onto a 30 µm filter placed in a 2 mL LoBind tube.
Rinse the homogenizer with 500 µL of Lysis Buffer and transfer it onto the same filter.
Incubate the samples on ice for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Sucrose Gradient Purification
steps.instruction: Purify nuclei using a two-step sucrose density gradient centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 2 mL tube with 500 µL of 1.2M Sucrose Solution.
Carefully layer the entire volume of cell suspension onto the 1.2M Sucrose Solution, avoiding mixing.
Centrifuge at 5000 x g for 20 minutes at 2 °C (Brake and Acceleration 1, 9).
Prepare a 1.5 mL tube with 500 µL of 1.2M Sucrose Solution.
Aspirate the upper phase and most of the lower phase, leaving 100-200 µL.
Resuspend the remaining volume in 1 mL of 1M Sucrose Solution.
Carefully transfer the entire mix onto the 1.2M Sucrose Solution prepared previously, avoiding mixing.
Centrifuge at 5000 x g for 20 minutes at 2 °C (Brake and Acceleration 1, 9).
Aspirate the upper phase and most of the lower phase, leaving 100-200 µL.

steps.title: Final Nuclei Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the purified nuclei to remove sucrose and other contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the remaining volume in 1 mL of Nuclei Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge at 1100 x g for 5 minutes at 2 °C (Brake and Acceleration 9, 9).
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 µL of Nuclei Wash Buffer.
Incubate the samples on ice for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Antibody Labeling
steps.instruction: Stain the nuclei with specific markers for microglial enrichment.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the desired amount of nuclei suspension into a 1.5 mL tube.
Add antibodies in recommended ratios: ACSA-2 (Ord No 130-116-245, APC, Miltenyi, 1:160), NeuN (Mab 377X, AF-488, Merck, 1:400), and PU.1 (81886S, PE, CST, 1:400).
Reserve a volume of suspension without antibodies as a Negative Control.
Incubate the suspension with antibodies overnight at 4 °C, protected from light.

steps.title: Post-Staining Wash and Final Filtration
steps.instruction: Remove unbound antibodies and perform a final filtration step.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1100 x g for 5 minutes at 2 °C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the nuclei in 1 mL of Nuclei Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge all samples, including the Negative Control, at 1100 x g for 5 minutes at 2 °C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend nuclei in 1 mL Nuclei Wash Buffer.
Filter the suspension through a 30 µm filter.
